searchText: PSA @everyone: it seems like the mailing list provider the EF uses for "updates@ethereum.org" has been compromised. We are currently trying to reach sendpulse.com to resolve the issue. Please don't click any links sent from that email. Here's a sample fake email that was received: https://x.com/timbeiko/status/1804721462407725441?s=46
